import pathlib,subprocess,os,json,hashlib,sys,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();out=root/'output/verification/cloud-full-ui-diagnostic-20261105'
meta=json.load(open(out/'predeclared.json'));assert hashlib.sha256((out/'observer.mjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==meta['observerSha256']
assert json.loads((root/'package.json').read_text())['scripts']['test:ui']==meta['script']
subprocess.run(['node',str(out/'environment.mjs')],check=True)
code="import {candidateFingerprint} from './support/acceptance/candidate.js';import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';const c=await candidateFingerprint();await writeFile(process.argv[1],JSON.stringify(c,null,2));console.log(c.sha256)"
actual=subprocess.check_output(['node','--input-type=module','-e',code,str(out/'candidate.before.json')],text=True).strip();assert actual==meta['candidate']
env=os.environ.copy();assert not env.get('NODE_OPTIONS');env['NODE_OPTIONS']='--import='+str(out/'observer.mjs');env['PARDNER_FULL_UI_TRACE_DIRECTORY']=str(out)
print('START_SINGLE_ORIGINAL_UI_SUITE '+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
result=subprocess.run(['node','scripts/verify-watchdog.js','--timeout','900','--log',str(out/'ui.log'),'--record',str(out/'ui.watchdog.json'),'--','npm','run','test:ui'],env=env)
print('SINGLE_UI_SUITE_EXIT '+str(result.returncode),flush=True);sys.exit(result.returncode)
